FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Answers to common questions about our remodeling services.
FAQ.question1: What types of remodeling services do you offer?
FAQ.answer1: We specialize in home and office remodeling, including kitchen and bathroom renovations, flooring, painting, and full interior redesigns.
FAQ.answer2: Yes, we offer professional design consultations to help you plan and customize your remodeling project according to your style and needs.
FAQ.question3: How long does a remodeling project take?
FAQ.answer3: Project duration varies depending on the scope of work. We provide a detailed timeline after evaluating your project.
FAQ.question4: Can I live in my home during the remodeling process?
FAQ.answer4: In most cases, yes. However, for extensive renovations, temporary relocation may be recommended to ensure safety and convenience.
FAQ.question5: Do you handle permits and approvals?
FAQ.answer5: Yes, we take care of all necessary permits and ensure compliance with local building regulations.
